//: Copy next to the agent's binaries on the CSV and point the clustered role's command line at it: HyperVCsiAgent.Service.exe --config C:\ClusterStorage\Volume1\HyperVCsiAgent\agent.config.json

Agent.//HostOperations: Attaching a disk goes through the Hyper-V host that currently owns the node's VM. Bounded per host, and on a shorter clock than disk operations because none of it is bulk I/O.
Agent.//Tls: The server certificate, issued by Let's Encrypt and renewed into the Windows store by certbot. Matched by subject rather than thumbprint so a renewal doesn't take the agent down; the store is re-read every ReloadInterval, so a new certificate is served without restarting the clustered role.
Agent.//Authentication: Fingerprints of the self-signed client certificates allowed to call this agent. The matching key lives in a Kubernetes Secret mounted into the CSI controller. List two during a rotation - add the new one, roll the driver, then remove the old.
